title: A History Of The World In 6 Glasses

questions.q: According to lesson 1, how was beer created?
questions.why: Lesson 1 says beer was discovered rather than invented.

questions.q: How did beer relate to the shift to farming?
a: Its appeal helped drive the desire to settle and farm
It was a cheap way to feed soldiers
It replaced water in hunting camps
questions.why: Lesson 1 says wanting more beer motivated settling and agriculture.

questions.q: Why did coffee appeal to Middle Ages intellectuals?
a: It was safe to drink without intoxication
questions.why: Lesson 2 says it had no negative effects and offered a clear-headed alternative to alcohol.

questions.q: What replaced taverns as gathering places?
questions.why: Lesson 2 notes the rise of coffeehouses offsetting alcohol-centered taverns.

questions.q: Who was the pharmacist who created Coca-Cola?
questions.why: Lesson 3 names John Pemberton as the Georgian pharmacist.
